name: Nocturnal-Pediment
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait perpetual storm systems, and everything the light never reaches.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Fossil beds suggest rich seas once flourished here; now the chemistry records only a slow suffocation.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Whoever controls biomass controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
